GNB.note: Document states nothing the study asks.
Amilcar Cabral cable is a planned project, unfunded; ACE is mentioned only as the cable to be backed up, with no landing or service statement.

facts.fact: ECOWAS Commissioner Sediko Douka said commitment to the Amilcar Cabral submarine cable (Cabo Verde to Liberia trunk, with extensions to Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea and Sierra Leone) was consolidated by a protocol of agreement signed at the second steering committee in April 2023; the study ($1m) and build ($25m) were still unfunded in June 2024.
